Keeping your toes healthy is important for overall foot care. Wash your feet daily with mild soap and dry them well, especially between the toes, to prevent moisture buildup. Trim your nails straight across to avoid ingrown toenails. Wear comfortable, breathable shoes that fit properly to prevent pressure and irritation. Moisturize your feet but avoid applying lotion between the toes to reduce the risk of fungal infections.
